caseNameFull: Scofield v. National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: James Urdan for petitioners., Solicitor General Griswold, Arnold Ordman, Dominick L. Manoli, and Norton J. Come for National Labor Relations Board, and Joseph L. Rauh, Jr., John Silard, Harriett R. Taylor, and Stephen I. Schlossberg for International Union, UAW, respondents., Walter S.
